Container.Name: SAdns
Container.Overview: DNS and network diagnostics with a password-protected dashboard, scheduled scans (Auto Run), history and trends, and AI-ready Markdown/JSON reports. In bridge mode, results describe the container's view; switch Network Type to host to measure the Unraid server's own network (an informed opt-in). On first start a password is printed once in the container log unless you set SADNS_PASSWORD.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: History, settings and the password hash. Must be writable by UID 10001 (chown 10001:10001).

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: 12+ characters. Leave empty to have one generated and printed once in the log.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Names you type in the browser besides IP addresses (comma-separated).

Config.Name: Network mode hint
Config.Description: bridge or host. Leave empty to auto-detect; set to host when using host networking.

Config.Name: Auto Run
Config.Description: true/false. Leave empty to configure in the UI.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for logs and schedule
